WORDS and MUSIC: Barney E. Warren, pub.1907. Public Domain.

How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings. Psa. 36:7 Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice. 63:7
